_about: laneS5 v1 STATUES THAT AREN'T. Ships DARK (enabled:false). The camp stone lion changes pose only while unseen, a little more each camp visit; saved in surprise_statues_save.json next to the other saves (sandbox dir under -savePath, never the real save while RunMode.RealSaveBlocked). Harness args: -s5:1 / -s5:0, -s5step:N (show step N, no gate, no save), -s5sweep:<seconds per step> (proof clip). A visit = walk into enterRadiusM of campCenter after being beyond leaveRadiusM for leaveSeconds; visit 1 = base pose, then every advanceEveryVisits visits arms ONE step; applied when the statue (bounds grown by frustumMarginM) was outside the camera frustum for unseenSeconds and the camera is >= minDistanceM away and SurpriseGate.TryClaim passes. Steps: towardFrac = how far the yaw turns from the row's own yaw toward lookAt (camp hearth x,z); forwardYawOffsetDeg = the GLB's own forward axis vs +Z (PROOF CALIBRATION: unknown until seen); towardM = metres moved toward lookAt; offsetM = extra world x,y,z; hide = renderers off + plinth stub. Last step = empty plinth.
